scenes.big: n8n can't reach Ollama? Check this
scenes.say: Running n8n in Docker and it can't reach your local Ollama model? It's usually one word.
Inside a container, localhost means the container itself, not your computer. Use host dot docker dot internal instead.
scenes.caption: Use host.docker.internal, not localhost

post.caption:
If n8n runs in Docker, 'localhost' points at the container, not your machine. To reach Ollama use http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1 (on Linux add --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway).
